items.stem: What is the main purpose of price or cost analysis before award?

options.text: To pick the vendor with the flashiest proposal
options.rationale: Proposal styling is not the basis of price analysis.

options.text: To determine whether the proposed price is fair and reasonable
options.rationale: Correct: price/cost analysis establishes fairness and reasonableness of the proposed price.

options.text: To guarantee the lowest possible price regardless of value
options.rationale: Reasonableness, not merely lowest price, is the aim.
Analysis supports negotiation; it does not replace it.

items.explanation: Correct: price/cost analysis establishes fairness and reasonableness of the proposed price.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Before entering a negotiation, why should a contract manager define a BATNA?

options.text: To ensure they never reach agreement
options.rationale: A BATNA supports good agreements, not avoidance of them.

options.text: To know their best alternative and set a rational walk-away point
options.rationale: Correct: a BATNA defines the walk-away point and strengthens negotiating position.

options.text: To hide information from their own team
options.rationale: A BATNA is internal preparation, not concealment from the team.

options.text: To fix the price before talks begin
options.rationale: A BATNA informs flexibility rather than fixing price.

items.explanation: Correct: a BATNA defines the walk-away point and strengthens negotiating position.

items.stem: Which TWO behaviours reflect strong ethics in contract management?

options.text: Disclosing and managing conflicts of interest
options.rationale: Correct: disclosing and managing conflicts is a core ethical behaviour.

options.text: Declining gifts that could improperly influence a decision
options.rationale: Correct: refusing improper gifts preserves integrity.

options.text: Accepting undisclosed payments from a supplier
options.rationale: Undisclosed payments are unethical and often illegal.

options.text: Steering an award to a relative's company secretly
options.rationale: Covert steering is a serious ethics violation.

items.explanation: Correct: disclosing and managing conflicts is a core ethical behaviour.
